messages:
anya: heads up — canary with the new tensor-pool worst-fit allocator is showing a ~3x increase in OOMs under our long-seq perf test. started around 1719452000.
kevin: ugh. which canary/sha?
anya: sha: b7f4c9a. run: `./deploy canary b7f4c9a --tag=tensorpool-worstfit`
matt: can you paste the allocator dump / small trace? short messages, please.
anya: paste below — short excerpt from the allocator trace and the nvidia logs
```
[alloc] slab0: free=12MB, largest_block=4MB
[alloc] slab1: free=6MB, largest_block=1.5MB
alloc request 8.2MB -> fallback path -> OOM (fragmentation)
nvidia: OutOfMemory on device 0, attempted allocate 8308992 bytes
```
anya: repro: `pytest tests/integration/test_serving_long_seq.py::test_multi_context --profile-alloc`
julia: does this only hit with KV cache enabled? that pins activation slots and makes fragmentation worse.
anya: yes — toggling KV cache off drops OOMs to baseline in the same canary run.
matt: suspect worst-fit increase fragmentation for repeated large logits allocations + scratchpads on long seqs. combined with batching=dynamic (microbatches) we end up with many small frees between large allocs -> holes.
kevin: quick experiment — try `REUSE_LARGE_LOGITS=false` and `POOL_STRATEGY=first_fit` in the runtime config on canary?
anya: tried first_fit locally, small improvement. turning off reuse_large_logits avoids allocating the huge single-buffer pattern, also better.
matt: likely root cause: worst-fit pushed large free chunk splits so subsequent large allocs fail even though total free >= request due to split sizes. KV cache pins small blocks across requests so fragmentation amplifies.
julia: can we also change workspace sizing to favor coalesced logits allocations (round-up to power-of-two) as mitigation?
matt: yeah we can add a quick heuristic: if req_size > 4MB round up to 4MB-aligned slots in the large-pool. makes allocation sizes sticky but reduces fragmentation.
kevin: can we ship a hotfix: revert worst-fit for large_pool, keep for small pools? simple gating in allocator?
matt: I pushed a PR that gates strategy by pool id: `if pool.is_large(): strategy = first_fit else worst_fit` — PR #4221
anya: ran the canary with that PR patched and KV cache on — so far 0 OOMs in 30 runs vs 18/30 before. pushing metrics now.
eng-bot: deploy status: canary deploy of pr/4221 succeeded to canary cluster at 1719457100 :white_check_mark:
kevin: nice. once stable, roll to dedicated. also add an alloc profiling dashboard: `runtime/alloc/fragmentation_ratio` and keep an eye on avg_free_block_size.
matt: follow ups: (1) investigate smarter coalescing on free, (2) consider adaptive batcher to avoid too many 1-token microbatches, (3) add a KV-cache-aware eviction hint to free pinned small slots proactively.
anya: creating follow-up issues and adding a short repro note in the PR. thanks everyone :tada:
kevin: great triage — leaving notes for SRE to watch oom-rate and tail-latencies for next 12h.
eng-bot: alert rule created: `runtime.ooms > 0.5/min on canary => page oncall` (severity: low)
